title: Base Double Command variant 4
purpose: Vary a meaningful pair of fields while preserving likely structural relationships.
expected_behavior: Client sends a standard Double Command with valid control code and qualifier, server processes the pair of fields (on/off, select/operate) according to IEC 60870-5-104 APCI framing.
constraints_preserved: Prefer widely recognized FT1.2 or IEC 60870-5-104 APCI framing
Diversify link control, interrogation, command and measurement paths
issue_safety_notes: No external protocol documents or vulnerability issues are used; protocol validity is model-prior plausibility.
